metadata.purpose: Sourced history of frontier and significant model availability across tracked Microsoft surfaces.
interpretation_rules: GitHub Models is not GitHub Copilot.
Foundry catalogue availability is not Copilot Studio availability.
An embedded or specialist Microsoft 365 experience is not general Copilot Chat model-picker availability.
An announcement of future availability is not first availability.
Current documentation proving support does not by itself prove the historical first-availability date.
N/F means no reliable public first date found, not unavailable.

confidence_definitions.confirmed: A primary source explicitly supports the material event date and scope.
confidence_definitions.supported: Strongly supported, but the exact first date relies on retrospective/current documentation or paired evidence.

events.evidence_note: Anthropic suspended Fable 5 and Mythos 5 after receiving a US Commerce Department export-control directive at 5:21pm ET, citing national security authorities. The directive barred access by any foreign national, whether inside or outside the United States and including Anthropic's own foreign national employees, which is why the shutdown applied to all customers globally; downstream access was affected.

sources.title: Statement on the US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
Redeploying Fable 5

events.evidence_note: Anthropic disabled Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all customers from 5:21pm ET on 12 June 2026 to comply with a US Commerce Department export-control directive barring access by any foreign national. The action was global and removed the models from partner distribution, including Microsoft Foundry.
events.caveat: Confidence is 'supported' rather than 'confirmed' because no Microsoft-issued Foundry suspension notice was located; the date is Anthropic's global compliance action. That Foundry was affected is established retrospectively by the CNBC re-enablement report rather than by a first-party Microsoft record.

sources.title: Statement on the US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
sources.quote: The net effect of this order is that we must abruptly disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all our customers.

validation_backlog.working_claim: Fable 5 availability in Microsoft Foundry was restored at some point after the export controls were lifted on 30 June 2026.
validation_backlog.reason: The 12 June suspension is now recorded canonically at 'supported' confidence, but no restoration date is established for Foundry. CNBC reported on 30 June 2026 that Anthropic would re-enable Fable 5 on Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry 'as soon as possible', which is an announcement of future availability rather than a first-availability date. Microsoft Learn currently lists claude-fable-5 as an available Anthropic-hosted preview, proving the end state but not the date.
validation_backlog.target: Locate a dated Microsoft Foundry re-enablement record, or a Learn page revision, that pins when Fable 5 returned to the Foundry catalogue.

validation_backlog.working_claim: Fable 5 availability in Microsoft Foundry was suspended alongside the vendor-level action on 12 June 2026.
validation_backlog.reason: Anthropic's directive statement is global and does not name Foundry, so Microsoft-side evidence was required before recording a Foundry state change.
validation_backlog.target: Locate dated Microsoft Foundry suspension evidence.
validation_backlog.resolution: CNBC's report that Anthropic would re-enable Fable 5 'on Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry' establishes retrospectively that Foundry distribution had been suspended. Promoted at 'supported' confidence because no Microsoft-issued notice exists. The restoration half remains open as foundry-fable5-restoration-2026.
